Connection Must Be More Than a Holiday Tradition

It’s Thanksgiving Day. For many of us, this means turkey and stuffing in the oven. Football playing in the background. Family and friends gathering to share a meal . And someone asking: “How about we go around and say what we’re thankful for?” People share stories, discuss milestones, maybe even acknowledge personal challenges.
